Definition: neuter of a presumed derivative of G2825; a pallet or little couch:--bed.
BiblicalUsage: Klinidion is a little couch, a pallet. Luke 5:19 has the friends letting the palsied man down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus, and Luke 5:24 has Jesus telling him to arise, and take up his couch, and go into his house.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the little couch carries the whole story: it lowered a man who could not walk, and it was carried home by a man who could.
